name: blackswan-xsection
description: The CROSS-SECTIONAL long/short screen (B1 §1) — a deliberately crude, deterministic ranking rule over a pre-registered multi-asset universe, run to FALSIFY the 3-4 week multi-asset env build cheaply. It asks 'will A outperform B?' rather than 'will this market go up?', because across 264 measured single-asset cells every apparent win was exposure reduction (mean beta 0.19, symmetric up/down capture), not directional skill. Long the top-k and short the bottom-k by trailing return, equal-weight, rebalanced every N bars, charged fees on turnover both ways. Benchmark for return_vs_hold_pct is the EQUAL-WEIGHT UNIVERSE BASKET, not a single asset. Produces no model; its cells are side-experiment evidence, kept in their own record type so they never mix with the single-asset RL run store.

universe.description: The PRE-REGISTERED symbol universe ranked against itself. US-session instruments only — mixing 24/7 crypto onto a session calendar is the hardest alignment case and is deferred to §2 rather than fudged. Choosing symbols after seeing results is selection-on-test, so this list is fixed in docs/cross-sectional-plan.md.

lookback.description: Trailing bars used to rank the universe (the momentum formation window).

k.description: How many symbols to hold on each side: long the top k, short the bottom k.

rebalance_days.description: Bars between re-rankings. Turnover — and therefore cost — scales with this, which is the term that killed the single-asset signal edge.

long_only.description: Drop the short leg (hold only the top k). The long/short book is NET FLAT by construction; long-only reintroduces the market beta the fork exists to remove, so this is the reference arm, not the thesis.

transaction_fee.description: Per-unit-of-turnover cost, charged on both entries and exits.

walk_forward_window.description: Which out-of-sample span is ACCOUNTED. The ranking may look back into the train span for its formation window, but only the test window's P&L is reported.

seed.description: Present for contract conformance only — the screen is fully deterministic, so seeds are not swept (three identical cells would fake replication).
